text:
maria_cs: morning team — quick check-in for Dunecrest private deployment. Harvest Ops, can we confirm network CIDR and whether there are existing /22s we need to avoid? Also want to lock the KMS policy before cutover.

harvest_ops: hey! current VPC is 10.24.0.0/16, but infra wants us to reserve 10.24.64.0/18 for internal tooling. no overlap with redwood subnets AFAIK.

maria_cs: perfect — thanks. Ajay, for the firewall rules, we had the doc saying outbound to 13.32.0.0/16 for redwood egress, is that still accurate?

ajay_se: correct, outbound 13.32.0.0/16 TCP 443. plus inbound only from our bastion IP for admin (TCP 22) during smoke run. we'll provide ephemeral IP list if you want CIDR instead of single IP.

julie_security: quick KMS note — please add the Redwood service principal to the key policy and enable "Allow use of the key" for the service role. example snippet in our docs but here's the minimal change we need on your CMK policy:

```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

julie_security: also confirm whether audit logs should be forwarded to your Splunk or to our managed observability pipeline (we can do both; retention varies).

harvest_ops: prefer Splunk for now. retention 365d. we'll share a forwarding role. need the exact bucket prefix for logs and the expected log format (json vs syslog).

dave_infra: logs: we send structured JSON with fields {service, instance_id, request_id, latency_ms}. prefix suggestion: s3://dunecrest-priv-logs/redwood/ . I'll attach the terraform snippet in the doc after this thread.

maria_cs: thanks. two action items from CS side: 1) we need the updated KMS key policy from Harvest so Julie can validate, 2) Harvest to confirm whether you want Redwood-managed replay for fallbacks (this affects billing + renewal notes).

harvest_ops: on replay — initially no. we'll evaluate after week1.

maria_cs: calling out renewal risk: flagged medium-high because audit logs and KMS validation are not complete yet. If we don't finish these by the cutover (T+4 days) we may need a waiver which impacts terms. tagging @julie_security to prioritize review.

julie_security: will prioritize — I can do a policy review within 24 hrs after you post the policy. recommend enabling key rotation and CMK alias naming to match our onboarding checklist: alias/redwood/dunecrest.

ajay_se: for IAM, please create these three roles in Harvest account: redwood-service (assume role), redwood-logs-writer, redwood-admin (least privilege). share ARNs and we'll add them to our onboarding playbook.

harvest_ops: ok i'll create roles today and post ARNs here once done.

maria_cs: small QA from the CS perspective: any blockers for the smoke test scheduled tomorrow 14:00 PST?

harvest_ops: firewall rule pending (bastion IP). KMS policy pending (julie review). otherwise good.

dave_infra: i'll stand by for the bastion IP and will run the smoke run checklist.

deploybot: Integration check passed for s3 log prefix connectivity (scan id 7b4c). no certs expired.

maria_cs: lovely — plan: Harvest to post KMS policy + bastion IP by EOD, Ajay & Julie to validate. CS to reconcile renewal risk after validations. We'll capture feedback in the onboarding doc (link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/dunecrest). Any objections?

harvest_ops: none. posting policy in 30m. thanks all :thumbsup:

ajay_se: ACK.

julie_security: ACK, will review when posted.

maria_cs: thanks team. I'll update the renewal risk to low if both KMS and logs are validated before cutover.
